description:
Implement foundational data models for query plan representation including
two-tier DAG structure (logical + physical operators), storage schema
extensions, and JSON serialization. This is the foundation that all other
workstreams depend on.

**Key Design Decisions**:
- Structured DAG representation only (no raw text storage)
- Two-tier: LogicalOperator (cross-platform) + PhysicalOperator (platform-specific)
- Opt-in capture via --capture-plans flag
- Plan fingerprinting for fast equality checks
